# orch8_credential (Resource)

A credential stored (encrypted) in the engine (`/credentials`) and referenced from sequences as `credentials://<id>`. `value` and `refresh_token` are write-only: the engine never returns them, so out-of-band changes are not detected, and after `terraform import` the next apply re-sends `value`. Updates use `PATCH /credentials/{id}`; removing an optional field forces replacement because PATCH cannot clear it.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Referenced from sequences as "credentials://sendgrid".
resource "orch8_credential" "sendgrid" {
  id          = "sendgrid"
  name        = "SendGrid API key"
  kind        = "api_key"
  value       = var.sendgrid_api_key
  description = "Transactional email"
}

variable "sendgrid_api_key" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Credential id (letters, digits, `-`, `_`, `.`; max 255).
- `name` (String) Display name.
- `value` (String, Sensitive) Secret value (max 256 KiB). Write-only.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Free-form description.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the credential can be resolved. Defaults to true.
- `expires_at` (String) RFC 3339 expiry (OAuth2 access tokens).
- `kind` (String) `api_key` (default), `oauth2`, or `basic`.
- `refresh_token` (String, Sensitive) OAuth2 refresh token. Write-only.
- `refresh_url` (String) OAuth2 token refresh URL.
- `tenant_id` (String) Tenant. Defaults to the provider's tenant_id.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp.
- `has_refresh_token` (Boolean) Whether a refresh token is stored.
- `updated_at` (String) Last update timestamp.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import by credential id. `value` is write-only; the next apply re-sends it.
terraform import orch8_credential.sendgrid sendgrid
```
